heading: Thursday Night
text: Increasing clouds. Showers likely west of the Greens, mainly after midnight; chance late east of Greens. Lows from the upper 30s to mid 40s, some mid 30s northeast. Winds becoming east to southeast a 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 35 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy with showers likely; a thunderstorm possible south. Highs in the mid to upper 60s in the south, and upper 50s to mid 60s north, with some mid 50s northeast. South to southeast winds 10 to 20 mph and gusting to 30 mph, except gusting to 40 mph in the Champlain Valley, and along the northern slopes of the Greens.

heading: Friday Night
text: Showers tapering off, mixing with or changing to snow showers late in the north, and over high terrain south. Lows in the upper 20s to low 30s north, in the 30s south. Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
